### PR-001 · Recover the refrigerant before opening the A/C system

*Climate · when: before the compressor, condenser or lines are disturbed · tools: a shop with recovery equipment · source: K-015*

The system still holds charge (it still cools a little — K-015), and venting refrigerant is illegal. Have a shop recover it **before** anything on the circuit is opened. Then pull the compressor, bracket, belt, condenser, receiver/drier and lines; leave the blower, heater core, HVAC case, ducts and doors alone; box the hardware rather than scrapping it — FB A/C parts are scarce and cooling returns with the new engine. The compressor is on its own belt, so nothing else on the crank is disturbed.

### PR-002 · Keep a stored lithium battery above its BMS cutoff

*Electrical · when: monthly while the Ionic S9 waits unfitted · tools: the Ionic app · source: electrical work item A4*

A lithium starter battery left to self-discharge into its BMS cutoff is hard to wake — some need a charger before the BMS will close again. While the Ionic S9 waits for the electrical build: open its app once a month, read the state of charge, and put it on a lithium-profile charger if it is below the app's low-charge warning. Never charge it below freezing without its heater running.
